## Overview

The International Symposium on Radiative Transfer, organised by the
International Centre for Heat and Mass Transfer (ICHMT), is the reference
meeting of the radiative-transfer community. It brings together scientists and
engineers working on the theory, measurement and application of thermal
radiation, with sessions on the radiative properties of surfaces and
participating media, spectral modelling, inverse methods and radiation in
combustion, atmospheric and engineering systems. The tenth edition was held in
Thessaloniki, 12 to 16 June 2023; the proceedings are published in the ICHMT
digital library (Begell House).
